findings.claim: When the re-ask Review call fails, Launch discards that error entirely and returns only the first shape refusal. Every reviewer failure of both adapters (exit error, timeout, missing binary, empty last message) wraps ErrReviewerDidNotAnswer with the reviewer stderr, so the cause of the second run never reaches the caller; the launch exits 2 with an old shape refusal and the owner cannot tell the reviewer replied badly from the reviewer crashed or timed out on the second run. No in-repo consumer branches on 1 vs 2 (tools/review-bench/run-ours.sh:62-64), so the reachable impact is lost diagnostics. A fix that keeps the first refusal as the outcome could still attach the second error.
proof_refs: diff-fix2.patch launch.go hunk: return Recorded{}, err replaced by return Recorded{}, refusal

evidence: Every adapter failure wraps ErrReviewerDidNotAnswer with stderr
